## Download public releases

Use the repository record for the version, files, license, and citation associated with each release. The links below provide access to published GRID project outputs.

| Product | Access | Release date | Download |
|---|---|---|---|
| U.S. river salinization and alkalinization: 226 sites | [Data and code on Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7937820) · [Details](highlights/usgs-226-stream-2023.qmd) | May 15, 2023 | ZIP, approximately 56 MB |
| ROcD-nGoM: northern Gulf of Mexico river–ocean database | [Data on Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10152141) · [Details](highlights/ROcD-nGoM-2024.qmd) | November 17, 2023 | ZIP, approximately 2.3 GB |
| River weathering data and machine-learning workflows | [Data and code on Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21846324) · [Details](highlights/weathering-ml-2026.qmd) | August 8, 2026 | ZIP, approximately 26.8 MB |

These releases represent selected outputs, not a download of the full GRID inventory. For other holdings or a specific data need, contact the [project team](/people/people.qmd) with the variables, region, time period, and intended use. See [Coverage](coverage.qmd), [Methods](methods.qmd), and [Data Use](data-use-and-embargo-policy.qmd) before combining products.

## Examples of watershed attributes

The table illustrates the kinds of environmental attributes relevant to GRID research. It is not a complete dictionary of the **{{< var inventory.watershed-properties >}} watershed properties** in the current inventory or a guarantee of availability at each site. Units and aggregation periods can differ by source and release; use the definitions accompanying your selected dataset.

| Attribute example | Example unit | Category |
|---|---|---|
| Runoff | mm per month | Hydrology |
| Soil moisture | m³ per m³ | Hydrology |
| Temperature | °C | Climate |
| Precipitation | mm per month | Climate |
| Watershed area | km² | Geomorphology |
| Erosion rate | mm per year | Geomorphology |
| Elevation | m | Geomorphology |
| Slope | degrees | Geomorphology |
| Aspect | degrees | Geomorphology |
| Soil organic carbon | g per kg | Soil chemistry |
| Soil pH | pH | Soil chemistry |
| Evaporite | % | Geology |
| Carbonate sediment | % | Geology |
| Siliciclastic sediment | % | Geology |
| Pyroclastic sediment | % | Geology |
| Mixed sediment | % | Geology |
| Unconsolidated sediment | % | Geology |
| Igneous basic | % | Geology |
| Igneous intermediate | % | Geology |
| Igneous acid | % | Geology |
| Metamorphic | % | Geology |
| Impervious surface area | % | Land use |
| Population density | people per km² | Land use |
| Cultivated vegetation | % | Land use |
| Urban | % | Land use |
| Trees | % | Land cover |
| Shrubs | % | Land cover |
| Herbaceous vegetation | % | Land cover |
| Flooded vegetation | % | Land cover |
| Snow and ice | % | Land cover |
| Barren | % | Land cover |
| Water | % | Land cover |

Percentage-based attributes require the source's spatial denominator and class definitions. Soil properties require depth information; climate and hydrology fields require their time period and aggregation method. Lithology labels above retain the example source terminology.
